description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating images, such as applying opacity, resizing logos to fit within a box, and overlaying logos onto base images with various constraints. The functions facilitate image composition workflows, especially for overlaying logos with size, position, and opacity controls.

methods.name: Image.Image _apply_opacity(img: Image.Image, opacity: float)
methods.description: Adjusts the opacity of an RGBA image by enhancing its alpha channel based on the specified opacity value.

methods.name: Image.Image _fit_logo_into_box(logo: Image.Image, box_w: int, box_h: int)
methods.description: Resizes a logo image to fit within specified width and height, preserving aspect ratio.

methods.name: None overlay_logo( base_image_path: Path, logo_path: Path, output_path: Path, *, position: Tuple[int, int] = (10, 10), scale: float = 0.2, opacity: float = None, max_logo_size_ratio: float = 0.4, target_box: Tuple[int, int, int, int] | None = None, )
methods.description: Main function to overlay a logo image onto a base image, with support for positioning, scaling, opacity, and size constraints.
